status: Native Cloudflare service bindings and callback RPC passed against the existing deployed ordinary Worker with installed SDK 0.9.0 and current SDK 0.10.0.

transport.provisioner: Alchemy createEdgeSession through CloudflareApiLive with profile minutei and non-interactive authentication
transport.consumer: Ephemeral native edge preview module; BOXES default service binding and BOXES_AGENT Agent entrypoint target the existing production Worker.
transport.rpc: Native Cloudflare callback RPC executed between Workers on Cloudflare, without a local callback proxy.
transport.authority: Only a 600-second read/write/execute capability scoped to the created sandbox enters the consumer request body. Administrator and management credentials stay in the local Effect program.
transport.accessPolicy: The proof refuses redirects or server failures during Access verification and never invokes interactive Access login.
transport.lifetime: The native preview session expires under Cloudflare lifecycle; this command has no explicit preview deletion receipt. No persistent consumer Worker is deployed.

verified: Callback input value 21 and output answer 42; exactly one callback in each run.
Void callback returns undefined; a subsequent execution has fresh globals.
Binding-written file remains readable through the separate deployed HTTP client after denied management.
Read/write/execute credential cannot dispose its sandbox (403) or execute in a different sandbox (401).
Scoped management finalizer disposes each sandbox and verifies its public file read returns 404 before the report is emitted.

validation.remoteCommands: Both native proof commands exited 0. Reports are emitted only after disposal and the post-disposal 404 check complete.
validation.localGate: bun run check passed: build, SDK declarations, TypeScript, workspace Clippy, workspace Cargo tests and native Bun tests.
validation.artifactIdentity: All six local production Worker files match the deployed runtime hashes. The three SDK 0.10.0 modules bundled by the remote proof match the exact delivery archive module bytes.
validation.minuteiCheckout: Clean at the recorded consumer commit after both remote proofs; no dependency, application or infrastructure changes.

reproduction.command: ALCHEMY_PROFILE=minutei CIRRO_WORKER=<deployed-worker-name> CIRRO_URL=<deployed-url> CIRRO_SDK_DIRECTORY=<installed-sdk-package-directory> bun run binding:remote:proof
reproduction.credentials: Provide CIRRO_API_KEY privately through the existing configuration owner. No token or preview authentication header is recorded here.

limits: A synthetic binding consumer uses the actual installed Minutei SDK exports and its Effect peer; the Minutei application itself is not deployed or exercised remotely.
Browser authentication, model tools, tenant lifecycle and history Queue delivery remain separate gates.
No production latency, CPU billing, cold-start or cost comparison is established.
GitHub and package publication remain deferred. Full AgentOS parity remains open.
